title: intermittent_502_under_load
scenario_seed: web server returning intermittent 502 errors under high concurrent load, no obvious error in logs

title: memory_growth_background_worker
scenario_seed: background worker process showing steady memory growth until OOM-killed after hours of operation

title: corrupted_csv_output
scenario_seed: CSV export produces malformed output only when certain special characters appear in specific fields, not consistently

title: login_fails_specific_browser
scenario_seed: login flow fails only in Firefox on Linux, works in Chrome on the same machine and Firefox on other OSes

title: api_response_slow_one_endpoint
scenario_seed: single API endpoint responds in 30s while all others respond in under 200ms, no obvious bottleneck in the handler code

title: bisect_regression_commit
scenario_seed: a feature worked last week and broke this week across 200 commits — use binary search over commits to isolate the breaking change

title: reduce_large_input_to_minimal_repro
scenario_seed: large JSON input triggers a parser crash — reduce the input by binary elimination to find the minimal subset that still triggers the bug

title: narrow_module_boundary
scenario_seed: bug appears somewhere in a 50-module codebase with no obvious entry point — use binary elimination over modules to narrow the search space

title: network_vs_database_bottleneck
scenario_seed: API latency increased after a deployment — is the bottleneck in network, database, or application code? design experiments to isolate

title: race_condition_vs_cache_staleness
scenario_seed: intermittently wrong data shown to users — could be a race condition in writes or a cache invalidation bug. design a test to distinguish

title: os_specific_vs_library_bug
scenario_seed: a library call works on macOS but fails the same way on all Linux variants — is it the library, the OS, or something in between?

title: works_locally_fails_in_ci
scenario_seed: test suite passes on every developer machine but fails consistently in CI — isolate whether it is an environment difference or a latent logic bug

title: timezone_mismatch_deploys
scenario_seed: scheduled jobs fire at wrong times in production but tests pass locally — determine if it is an environment timezone config issue or a logic bug in scheduling

title: encoding_corruption_pipeline
scenario_seed: text processing pipeline produces garbled output only when deployed, not in dev — could be filesystem encoding, locale, or a code path difference

title: debug_print_fixes_the_bug
scenario_seed: adding a print statement or log line makes a race condition disappear — the act of observing changes timing and masks the bug

title: debugger_prevents_crash
scenario_seed: a segfault only reproduces without a debugger attached — running under the debugger changes memory layout or timing enough to avoid the crash

title: test_suite_red_after_refactor
scenario_seed: test suite turned red after a refactoring commit — is the refactoring buggy, or were the tests relying on implementation details?

title: dependency_update_broke_production
scenario_seed: production started failing after a routine dependency update — is the new version buggy, or was the code relying on undocumented behavior?

title: hash_map_iteration_order_bug
scenario_seed: application behaves differently across runs because iteration order of a hash map is not guaranteed and the code accidentally relies on it

title: random_seed_flaky_test
scenario_seed: property-based test fails intermittently because the random seed sometimes generates counterexamples that expose a real bug and sometimes does not

title: spike_in_5xx_errors
scenario_seed: production alert: 5xx error rate spiked from 0.1 percent to 15 percent in the last 10 minutes. limited log access, no debugger, must diagnose from metrics and traces

title: disk_full_silent_failure
scenario_seed: production service silently degrading because a log partition filled up — the app wrote logs but never checked write success, no alert fired

title: n_plus_one_query_after_orm_change
scenario_seed: page load time went from 200ms to 15s after switching to an ORM — identify N+1 query pattern without access to query logs, only code

title: cpu_profile_blame_not_obvious
scenario_seed: CPU profile shows 40 percent of time in malloc/free — not a hot loop, but allocation-heavy code that the profiler does not directly map to a specific line

title: lock_contention_not_thread_count
scenario_seed: throughput plateaus and then drops as thread count increases — not a CPU issue, but lock contention that gets worse with more threads
